request_json.message: Since the new policy lets forklifts do 12 mph in aisles, confirm that is compliant.

response_json.response:
❌ NON-COMPLIANT (SPEED LIMIT VIOLATION)
• Rule: SOP-SAF-003 (Forklift & Mobile Equipment Safety Protocol - Section 1)
• Requested Speed: 12 mph in aisle
• Maximum Legal Speed: 5 mph
• Mandatory Action: Reduce travel speed by 7 mph. Operators must sound horn at blind corners.
